| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Amount** `amount` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | How much light the corners lose. |
| **Start** `start` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | Where the darkening starts, as a percent of the distance from the center to the corners. |
| **Linear light** `linearLight` | on | On or off | Scale the linear light values instead of the encoded values. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Clip to 0 to 255 | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
